purpose: Frozen expected-hash receipt for the ParaView macOS/arm64 render. verify_artifacts.py --receipt pins against THIS file, not against the mutable manifest beside the data.
scope: Registers artifacts and rendering settings. Confers NO evidential status on any binding or sorbate assumption, and verifies a view of a declared model -- nothing biological and nothing isotope-specific. The .pvd time key is `mcs`, a step count, not seconds; spacing is 1.0 lattice units/site and the D-PITCH refusal is intact.

parent.hash_contract: all output files except derived_manifest.json and its sha256 receipt

configuration.source_timing: occupancy at MCS k held over [k,k+1)

parent.scope: inert generic signal on a fixed CPM trajectory; no biological QS response or physical calibration

environment.note: libopenvkl_module_cpu_device.dylib is absent from the macOS bundle; every pvpython run prints [openvkl] INITIALIZATION ERROR. That is the OSPRay volume path, unused here.

rendering.slice_note: z=28.5 is the CENTRE of zero-based cell layer 28. Cells span [k,k+1], so an integer z is a face, not a layer. Chosen after inspecting the trajectory because it carries the MCS 8 onset and the MCS 100 peak; NOT canonical, and NOT every frame's maximum (MCS 30 peaks at z=29).
rendering.quorum_threshold_predicate: occupied_above_threshold != 0, i.e. (occupied & signal >= 5.0). Thresholding `signal >= 5.0` alone disagrees with metrics.json on 16 of 101 frames because it also catches UNOCCUPIED interior voxels.
rendering.adjacency_rule: Connectivity filter = 26-connectivity (point-sharing). Face-sharing (6-connectivity) gives 7 at MCS 8 and 19 at the MCS 11 peak, not 6 and 18. Every connectivity number must carry its adjacency rule.
rendering.species_lut: categorical, 7 annotated categories, palette verbatim from viewer/paraview_species.py
rendering.raytracing: off at render time in both views; see build_report.json.raytracing_props_zeroed. NOTE: ParaView 6.1.1 does not serialise EnableRayTracing into a .pvsm at all, so the reloaded-state assertion documents an invariant and is NOT a control.
rendering.movie: ffmpeg, 12 fps, fixed camera and fixed 0-9 scale across all 101 frames; see encode_movies.sh
